metadata.title: Drift and joint minimal displacement for groups acting on hyperbolic spaces
metadata.abstract: We obtain a uniform lower bound for the drift of random walks on hyperbolic spaces in terms of joint minimal displacement. Our main theorem applies to weakly acylindrical actions on Gromov-hyperbolic spaces and is quantitative in all relevant constants. For discrete isometry groups of Hadamard manifolds with pinched negative curvature, the required assumptions are automatically satisfied by the Margulis lemma. This yields uniform gaps at zero in drift spectra for pinched negatively curved Hadamard manifolds, hyperbolic groups, and mapping class groups acting on curve graphs.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 在弱非柱状的双曲空间作用中，以联合最小位移控制随机游走漂移的统一下界，常数依赖均可量化；借 Margulis 引理应用于夹逼负曲率 Hadamard 流形的离散等距群，并获得若干漂移谱在零点的统一间隙。
analysis.breakthrough: 将作用的几何位移和概率漂移联系成适用于多种群的定量工具。
